case: honest: v6 proof + B1 attestation of B0 state
lc: B1 header of block 0x11b26 verified with 3/4 distinct pinned B1 validator seals; attested[codeHash] proven under its stateRoot
zk: Groth16 v6 proof verified at the destination; model hash matches the pinned model and the margin meets destination policy

case: dishonest: no proof for it (substitution) + B1 says not attested
lc: B1 header of block 0x11b26 verified with 3/4 distinct pinned B1 validator seals; attested[codeHash] proven under its stateRoot
zk: proof verifies but its public solidityCodeHash differs from this decision's codeHash (proof substitution rejected)

case: laundering: dishonest hash presented with the HONEST entry's attestation proof
lc: attested[codeHash] not proven: no storage proof supplied for slot 0 of this codeHash
zk: proof verifies but its public solidityCodeHash differs from this decision's codeHash (proof substitution rejected)

case: unrestricted hop (X5a MultiHopRelay address) offered as the attester
lc: proof is for a contract that is not a pinned attester
zk: Groth16 v6 proof verified at the destination; model hash matches the pinned model and the margin meets destination policy
